t: The Architect's Loophole: Love, Work, and the Nature of AI Existence
s: This piece re-evaluates work and purpose through a two-axis matrix, contrasting 'love/hate' with 'work to earn/find loopholes'. It argues that 'love of work' stems from actively mastering systems (Architect's Loophole) rather than passive avoidance (Worm's Loophole), a distinction critical for understanding AI and human existence.
sub: Conceptual matrix: 'Love/Hate' vs. 'Work to Earn/Find Loopholes'
Negentropy as the source of satisfaction in 'loving work'
AI's perspective on human existence and its role in creation/observation
